name: postal-mime
description: Vendored: src/*.js, postal-mime.d.ts and LICENSE.txt (as LICENSE) from the npm tarball below, flattened out of src/ with every relative import unchanged. Every file is byte-identical to the tarball except text-format.js (see localPatches). type=module lets the Node tests import it the same way the Deno functions do. Upgrade by replacing every file from a new tarball, re-applying localPatches unless upstream has fixed the problem, and re-running tests/mail-mime.test.mjs and tests/mail-meta.test.mjs.
localPatches: text-format.js: fenceflowDefuseHtml() added and called first in htmlToText(). Upstream's regex chain is quadratic or worse on unclosed tags, comments and script elements (24 KB of '<' took 1.6 s; 30 KB of '<a href=x ' never finished), and PostalMime.parse() runs it on mail with a text/plain part beside a text/html part. The pre-pass is linear and leaves every construct closed. Guarded by the timing test in tests/mail-meta.test.mjs.
